question: Kamal and her sister together have Rs. 2,100. On taking Rs. 300 from her sister, Kamal will have the same amount as what her sister had earlier. Find the ratio of the initial amounts that Kamal and her sister had.
solution:
**Given**

Total money = Rs.2100

**Calculation**

let the Kamal's sister has Rs. x 

so, Kamal has Rs.(2100 - x)

According to question

x = 2100 - x + 300

⇒ x + x = 2400

⇒ 2x = 2400

⇒ x = 1200

Initial amount Kamal's sister had = Rs.1200

Kamal had 2100 - 1200

⇒ 900

Ratio of initial amount = 900 ∶ 1200

⇒ 3 ∶ 4

**∴ The ratio of the initial amounts that Kamal and her sister had is 3 ∶ 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Kamal and her sister together have Rs. 2,100.

K + S = 2100 .......(1)

On taking Rs. 300 from her sister, Kamal will have the same amount as what her sister had earlier. 

K + 300 = S .......(2)

Put the value of (2) in (1),

K + K + 300 = 2100

K = 900

S = 1200 

Ratio of initial amount = 900 ∶ 1200

⇒ 3 ∶ 4

∴ The ratio of the initial amounts that Kamal and her sister had is 3 ∶ 4
